vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: notes-snapshot-control-room
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle provides instructions for an agent to manage a local Apple Notes backup utility via the `notesctl` command-line tool. It focuses on local preflight verification, MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration, and diagnostic workflows (e.g., `./notesctl doctor`, `./notesctl mcp`). The instructions and metadata in SKILL.md and manifest.yaml are clearly aligned with the stated purpose of local-first data management on macOS and do not exhibit signs of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only control-room guide that coherently documents how to run and verify a local Apple Notes Snapshot MCP (notesctl) workflow and does not request unrelated credentials, installs, or external endpoints.

dimensions.detail: The name and description match the runtime instructions: the skill teaches how to prove local state and wire notesctl mcp into a host. It does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and reference docs instruct the agent to run local notesctl commands and to check local status/doctor/verify output. They do not ask the agent to read arbitrary host files, access other services, or exfiltrate data. External links are only documentation pages.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present; this is instruction-only so nothing is downloaded or written by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths; the documented commands operate on a local notesctl checkout, which is proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package is essentially documentation telling an agent how to run a local notesctl-based proof and MCP attach flow. It appears internally consistent and low-risk, but exercise normal caution: only run the referenced ./notesctl binary if you trust its source; review the notesctl code or run it in a confined environment before granting it broad filesystem access. If you plan to allow an agent to execute these steps autonomously, ensure the agent's execution privileges are limited (so it cannot run arbitrary host commands beyond the notesctl workflow).
